current_answer: Choose by task, agent, source revision, and the instructions actually loaded. On an existing screen, define the route, content, components, tokens, required states, and viewports before choosing a skill. Compare a pinned skill with the same no-skill brief on the same model and project. Judge visual-system fit and functional behavior separately, then note time and token cost. A good screenshot alone is not a task win; no catalogue listing has a pool-run paired outcome comparison.

catalogue_card.question: Would you accept a prettier screen if the flow broke?
catalogue_card.text: A frontend skill trial needs two checks: visual-system fit and working behavior. A web-app agent benchmark found that visual and functional results can diverge; it did not test our listed skills. Compare a pinned skill with the same no-skill brief before choosing.

summary: Choose by task, agent, pinned or declared mutable source, and loaded instructions.
For an existing screen, fix the route, content, tokens, components, states, and viewports before a skill trial.
